# SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-23 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Structure and components

- [statement] In the MongoDB `master` `DistinctScan` implementation checked on 2026-10-21, shard-filtering an individual orphan document increments that stage's `chunkSkips`, while skipping orphan chunks increments the separate `orphanChunkSkips` statistic. Therefore, a `chunkSkips` field by itself does not prove that the plan contains a `SHARDING_FILTER` stage. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-21) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/distinct_scan.cpp · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/, https://help.aliyun.com/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] MongoDB says explain fields used internally may be undocumented and that listed output fields can change, so treat the exact presence and shape of `chunkSkips` as diagnostic output rather than a stable application interface. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://help.aliyun.com/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster

## Facts and statements

- [statement] SHARDING_FILTER is MongoDB's execution stage for filtering orphan documents from a shard. For a sharded explain, execution statistics are reported per accessed shard, and chunkSkips appears among the stage statistics. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster
- [statement] chunkSkips counts orphan documents filtered by SHARDING_FILTER on the current shard for that execution. Alibaba's example shows two input documents filtered and chunkSkips: 2; Huawei describes the field as the number of orphaned documents on the current shard. (high confidence) — https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/es-us/drs_faq/drs_09_0101.html
- [statement] Treat chunkSkips as a statistic for the specific explain execution, not as a persistent collection-wide inventory. Huawei's collection-wide check uses find().explain("executionStats") and warns that it scans every document across all shards, can take a long time, and can create query pressure. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/es-us/drs_faq/drs_09_0101.html
- [statement] MongoDB defines `SHARDING_FILTER` as the execution stage that filters orphan documents from shards. In a plan that uses this stage, `chunkSkips` reports documents rejected by that filter. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://help.aliyun.com/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster
- [statement] For a collection-wide orphan check, Alibaba Cloud and Huawei Cloud instruct users to run an unfiltered `find().explain("executionStats")` and inspect each shard. Huawei says a nonzero `chunkSkips` identifies orphan documents on that shard; Alibaba's example shows the counter for documents filtered by `SHARDING_FILTER`. (high confidence) — https://help.aliyun.com/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/es-us/drs_faq/drs_09_0101.html
